//: MCP server registry for served chat models. Copy to configs/mcp-servers.json (or point settings.mcp_servers_config elsewhere). Callers reference servers BY NAME via the chat request's 'mcp_servers' field; only servers listed here are reachable. Transports: 'streamable-http' (remote server at 'url', optional auth 'headers') or 'stdio' (spawn 'command' locally, optional 'env'). Requires the optional dependency: pip install 'docie-bench[mcp]'.
